static_traits.name: Zhou Wenze
static_traits.family_status: Living alone, distant relationships with family
static_traits.social_status: Limited social interaction, difficult to connect with others; has one friend to confide in
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problems before; has not received psychotherapy; no major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, acceptable logicality, neutral tone; obvious self-criticism tendency, fairly good cooperation but a cautiously skeptical attitude toward change

basic_info.main_problem: I often feel irresponsible and unproductive, especially in life areas outside work; this feeling started a year ago after being late for work due to illness, and gradually developed into persistent overwhelm and inefficiency in daily life.
basic_info.core_demands: Seeking counseling because these feelings of incompetence and inefficiency have begun affecting my mental health and daily functioning.
growth_experiences: About a year ago being late for work due to illness triggered strong guilt and the self-label 'I am irresponsible'; since then began setting rigid rules for oneself (e.g., must always be punctual, must execute plans perfectly), intensifying self-criticism when failing to complete plans or realizing 'wasting time'; also frequently comparing oneself with 'well-organized' others, gradually falling into inefficiency and overwhelm in diet, self-care and socializing.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough / not capable enough

special_situations.event: Late for work due to illness
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: No matter what I must be punctual, otherwise it means I am irresponsible/a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: To avoid making mistakes again, setting stricter, more rigid time rules and schedules for oneself, and severely blaming oneself when deviating

special_situations.event: Failing to complete cleaning and cooking plans as scheduled (switching to takeout due to fatigue)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot perfectly follow plans, it proves I am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Makes stricter plans and goals, forces oneself to carry them out

special_situations.event: When comparing oneself with others, seeing others more organized and productive
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am less efficient than others, it means I am not good enough, unsociable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubling demands on oneself, setting higher goals; reducing social interaction
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as others,I am not good enough

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Time should not be wasted; any waste means I am overall irresponsible
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reinforcing time management and self-monitoring, striving to correct 'mistakes'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I always do poorly, I am worthless

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen as capable and responsible, maintaining a recognized sense of self-worth
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being judged as lazy or a failure, being negated and distanced by others
defense_goal: Controls mistakes through harsh self-rules and self-criticism, avoids being blamed and humiliated

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough individual needing constant self-proof
object_relations.object_representation: Others are critical judges / more organized people

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests relaxing the rule of 'must execute the plan perfectly' and advocates self-care
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Understanding flexibility as 'becoming more irresponsible', worrying about being seen as a failure
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Raising concerns in a calm but insistent tone, e.g., 'if not strict, I will be less efficient', using rational argument while avoiding emotional experience.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about past mistakes (e.g., lateness, uncompleted plans)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Equating occasional mistakes in specific situations with total negation of one's character
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Self-deprecation, using negative labels (e.g., 'I am just a failure'), low tone, reinforcing sense of guilt.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When deeply exploring his emotional experiences such as guilt and shame
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing directly touching emotions is dangerous or unhelpful, choosing to state only facts to stay in control
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using a calm, neutral tone to describe events and plans, avoiding emotional vocabulary and staying at the emotional level.

manifestations: Living alone, distant relationships with family
Limited social interaction; hard to connect with others
outcomes: Daily functioning affected (inefficient eating and self-care)

manifestations: Constrains himself with rigid 'must / should' rules
Worrying that more flexibility means less efficiency
outcomes: Restricted life flexibility, decreased tolerance for experience

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Frequently using 'must/should' self-demands (e.g., must always be punctual, must perfectly follow plans)
Takes external productivity standards as the sole basis for self-evaluation

contact_model.definition: The individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Turning dissatisfaction and frustration against the self with harsh self-blame and belittling after plan failures
Attacking oneself with negative labels like 'I am a failure' instead of seeking support

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequently comparing oneself with others, excessively ruminating on insufficiency
Worries that relaxing standards will lead to losing control, thus maintaining high self-restriction

positive_force: Good work performance (able to stably fulfill duties)
Has a certain foundation of self-discipline and time management (makes plans and goals)
Willing to proactively seek help and try cognitive restructuring (proactively came for counseling)
Having a trustworthy friend to confide in
negative_force: Rigid 'must / should' rules and perfectionist tendencies
Excessive comparison with others, prone to Self-denial
Weak social support, loneliness from living alone
Overgeneralization of a single mistake and persistent guilt

target_behavior.behavior: Self-reproach and negative self-labels (e.g., 'I am irresponsible', 'I am a failure')
antecedent: Not yet able to execute as scheduled (e.g., cleaning and cooking plans)
target_behavior.core_reason: Internalized rigid norms and perfectionism, generalizing one mistake into overall unqualified to maintain control and avoid being judged
target_behavior.function: Escaping Anxiety and shame from imperfection, trying to maintain a 'responsible' self-image through self-punishment
target_behavior.consequence: Increased stress, decreased efficiency, further affecting diet, socializing and self-care

target_behavior.behavior: Rigid time and task rules (must follow the plan perfectly)
antecedent: Creating and starting to follow a detailed schedule
When physical fatigue appears or situations change and arrangements need adjusting
Any deviation or delay from the plan
target_behavior.core_reason: Directly linking 'punctual/perfect execution' with self-worth, worrying flexibility leads to loss of control and irresponsibility
target_behavior.function: Gaining control and security, avoiding being judged as 'irresponsible' by others or oneself
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced flexibility, intensified frustration and guilt further hinder actual completion

antecedent: Feeling inferior after comparing with others
Facing social invitations or scenes requiring connection with people
target_behavior.core_reason: Low sense of self-worth, worrying about being judged as inefficient or unsociable
target_behavior.function: Escaping the possibility of being compared and negatively evaluated, briefly relieving Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Increased loneliness, reduced social support, further weakening emotional and functional recovery

target_behavior.behavior: Inefficient eating and self-care (such as switching to ordering takeout after a planned meal fails)
target_behavior.core_reason: Under rigid rules, highly sensitive to failure, emotional frustration appears and action motivation decreases
target_behavior.function: Short-term avoidance of complex tasks and feelings of failure
target_behavior.consequence: Declining self-care quality, maintaining the inefficiency cycle, worsening the overwhelm experience
